title: Offline evidence-chain rehearsal
hypothesis: The merged RND-0020/21/22 contracts can produce a deterministic review dossier from one exact-head evidence set while missing, failed and cross-revision evidence retain fail-closed semantics and human-only authority.
result: RUNNING. Focused integration tests cover PASS, REVIEW_REQUIRED, FAIL_CLOSED, cross-head mismatch, scope/path mismatch and duplicate-label failure. Independent final-head validation and human review remain pending.
